value.rationale: On a canonical finite Boolean compatibility frame, the exact image of the joint operator, complete fiber census and sharp double-exponential typical-input collapse form a natural structural and probabilistic modal-algebra invariant. They measure information loss at one modal step and contrast with the previous result that a carefully chosen single valuation can generate all propositions. This is neither an arbitrary data slice nor merely a restatement of normal modal duality.
